limits: Only synthetic local/mock behavior tested. No external model, web, live connector, deployment, human semantic review or competitive superiority is accepted by this evidence
Fixture commands and direct service publication probes validate transport, state and authority, not natural-language editing quality
Test counts are structural evidence and are not summed into a general quality score
Parent owns compiled-browser E2E, accessibility/mobile acceptance, full regression and raw-versus-focused interaction measurements
Binary readback checks tested text/cells and literal formula handling, not full Office fidelity, exhaustive typography or every possible document
Extracted source kit explicitly reuses this host's trusted installed Python dependencies. It is not clean-machine, cross-platform or self-contained binary acceptance
Private backup retains trusted private candidate/audit/session state by design; content handoff does not carry execution or approval authority
Database checks and hashes are not authentication or a sandbox for arbitrary malicious SQL archives. Restore only trusted operator-owned private backups
Old noncooperating AW07 workers must be stopped before upgrade; advisory ownership does not discover or control them
